اعتطفا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفَا (iʕtaṭafā) /iʕ.ta.tˤa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفَا (uʕtuṭifā) /uʕ.tu.tˤi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اِعْتَطِفَا (iʕtaṭifā) /iʕ.ta.tˤi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
